verdicts.label: quality_relevant

verdicts.justification: Measures whether the text is complete/self-contained enough to be judged at all, a data-completeness/production-circumstance check rather than a signal of the underlying research's quality.

verdicts.label: quality_relevant

verdicts.justification: Explicitly stating a checkable limitation or failure regime is a genuine scientific-honesty and rigor signal.
